sections.title: Six kids and a long career

items.q: What changed around Whittaker between 20 and now?
items.a: He started at **20 with no kids**. He is now **married with 6 kids**, a mortgage, and a **Musashi** line. Fighters drop out, he says, because **life goes on around the sport**.

items.q: Where does age show up when he is not in camp?
items.a: Picking up one of his kids gave him a **twinge**. Past **35**, he will not **dead-sprint from a stop** without a long warmup — and if his boys challenge him, he still has to **beat them**.

items.q: Why did the last middleweight camps stop being worth it?
items.a: He was **cutting from about 205 to 185**. He **did not enjoy** the cut, the diet, or trying to be present for **6 kids while starving**. A small sadness: clothes fitted at **fight weight** do not fit when he walks around.

items.q: What does Joe want instead of the cut?
items.a: Fight at the weight you are when you are **healthy**: full meals, carbs, water, **never dehydrated**, about **10% body fat**. He wants **random weigh-ins** the way **USADA** does random tests, so a **170** fighter who walks at **208** is in the wrong class.

items.q: What changed in his head moving to light heavyweight?
items.a: **Everyone has a touch of death**. They are still **fast enough to land**, just **heavier**. You **cannot play games** the way you can at middleweight.

items.q: How is he training now that he has moved up?
items.a: **Either I have it by now or I don't.** Camps are **mitt work, light sparring, and gi rounds** — review, not a rebuild — and he is trying to **enjoy the process**.

items.q: When does hard cardio ruin the skill work?
items.a: Whittaker says skills get **sloppy when you are broken down**. **Cub Swanson** said some of his **worst performances** followed **Sam Calavita's** garage sessions because they **cross the line**. Fatigue helps only when you are rehearsing a skill you **already own**.

items.q: Why does he treat gymnastics as the base?
items.a: His wife came from **elite gymnastics**. A fight never holds you in a **balanced position**, so he wants **imbalance and single-side work** under him before the gas tank.
